critical_debugging_areas.proof_focus: block numbers, quote timestamps, Redis TTLs, report freshness, fork upstream block.
critical_debugging_areas.why_it_matters: Arbitrage and AI decisions decay when block, cache, quote, or model state is stale.

critical_debugging_areas.proof_focus: Decimal usage, floor conversions, raw/unit transforms, gas native/USD accounting.
critical_debugging_areas.why_it_matters: Wei, gwei, POL, token decimals, USD, raw units, and rounding direction decide whether calldata reverts.

critical_debugging_areas.proof_focus: TOKEN_ADDRESSES, TOKEN_DECIMALS, apprentice promotions, token calibration, on-chain ERC20 checks.
critical_debugging_areas.why_it_matters: Symbol collisions, bridged variants, stale decimals, and bad pool metadata can create false spreads.

critical_debugging_areas.proof_focus: pool quality filters, route signatures, protocol family semantics, pool hydration completeness.
critical_debugging_areas.why_it_matters: Raw-positive routes collapse when duplicate or shallow liquidity is counted as executable depth.

critical_debugging_areas.proof_focus: net_profit_usd, gas_cost_usd, flashloan_fee_usd, extra_slippage_buffer_usd, min profit floors.
critical_debugging_areas.why_it_matters: Flash fee, swap fee, gas, relay cost, slippage, and risk buffers must be subtracted before execution.

critical_debugging_areas.proof_focus: requests/httpx/aiohttp, Web3 providers, redis writes, JSON report imports, fallback sources.
critical_debugging_areas.why_it_matters: RPC, oracle, Redis, subgraph, and file snapshots are separate trust boundaries with different failure modes.

critical_debugging_areas.proof_focus: payload envelopes, exact-call simulation, adapter source IDs, ABI encoding, revert decoding.
critical_debugging_areas.why_it_matters: A profitable quote is not executable unless adapter semantics and encoded route calldata match the executor.

critical_debugging_areas.proof_focus: background loops, Redis streams, JSON writes, runtime settings, registry mutation points.
critical_debugging_areas.why_it_matters: Discovery, metadata runners, watchers, API controls, and engine loops can race over shared registries.

critical_debugging_areas.proof_focus: sign_transaction, send_raw_transaction, receipt gas, owner checks, canary mode, live acknowledgements.
critical_debugging_areas.why_it_matters: Only the user wallet pays gas; nonce, balance, signing key, and broadcast lane mistakes are live-risk events.

critical_debugging_areas.proof_focus: feature inputs, labels, model version, fail-closed status, ranker overrides versus hard gates.
critical_debugging_areas.why_it_matters: ML can improve prioritization, but stale labels or leakage can promote routes that fail executor truth.
